meta.name: modern_hellenist
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

programs.brief: A colossal many-tentacled sea monster breaks through the harbor beside the modern Hellenist city, its wet scaled body and fins rising from real water while huge tentacles reach toward the waterfront streets and a shattered quay.

Distinct smaller sea monsters surface along a landing trail from the sea inlet toward the city: fins, tentacles, wet tracks, spray and broken quay debris make each one readable at street scale and show a clear direction of advance.

tokens.invasion: sea monsters are invading the city

root.label: the modern Hellenist city under assault from the sea
